Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly claimed that Osiris (the Egyptian god of the underworld) belongs to the Ogdoad (Hermopolitan pantheon); Osiris is not part of the Ogdoad but is traditionally associated with the Ennead of Heliopolis and, broadly, the Egyptian pantheon. The Planner also prematurely declared the task complete without verification or use of available capabilities.
